name: comp-70
blurb: Textarea with a full-width Send button.
description: A textarea with an outline Button spanning the full width (w-full) below it. For form submission.
use_when: Mobile or narrow forms where full-width buttons are expected and prominent.
avoid_when: You need compact, icon-only, or right-aligned buttons.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Button is full-width and clearly labeled.
